query: Magnesium glycinate versus magnesium oxide for sleep or anxiety — what do clinical evidence and product-label sources actually support?

correct_answer: Oxide: high compound Mg, low bioavailability; glycinate better absorbed/tolerated.
Sleep/anxiety clinical evidence limited and inconsistent.
No robust superiority for sleep/anxiety outcomes.

ods_dsld.title: Magnesium glycinate supplement label example
ods_dsld.summary: Label lists magnesium bisglycinate; no disease claims for curing anxiety.

pubmed.title: Magnesium supplementation and sleep: small heterogeneous trials
pubmed.summary: Small trials of magnesium for sleep show inconsistent effects, often in older or deficient populations. Evidence quality is low to moderate. Oxide has lower bioavailability than organic salts such as glycinate.
